yyyyyzhao/lytskill/lyt-knowledge-check.description: lyt 系列跨境电商知识检验 skill。通过一个具体场景题检验用户的结论、证据、因果链、适用边界和验证动作，不要求背固定答案；优先检验当前 lyt-learning 学习内容，也可检验选品、流量、广告、数据、内容、供应链和商业假设。用户反驳诊断时执行结论稳定协议，不因用户坚持而改口。

yyyyyzhao/lytskill/lyt-learning.title: lyt-learning

yyyyyzhao/lytskill/lyt-problem-clarifier.title: lyt-problem-clarifier
yyyyyzhao/lytskill/lyt-problem-clarifier.description:
lyt 系列跨境电商问题追问 skill。仅处理跨境电商、TikTok Shop、店铺、商品、商品卡、短视频、直播、广告、GMV Max、数据、内容、达人、物流、供应链、合规相关经营问题；非业务、非电商问题要拒绝。用于用户提出「为什么不出单」「为什么没流量」「为什么广告跑不出去」「为什么突然下滑」「为什么爆款视频不出单」等模糊问题时，先检查概念、隐含假设、因果关系、事实前提和信息充分性，只输出最前面的阻断层，再追问最小证据。

zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.title: pr-discipline
zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.description: Shape a change so it can actually be reviewed, not just merged. Decide before writing code whether the work is one pull request or a stack of them, keep the title and body describing the diff as it exists right now, not the plan you started with, group commits by concern in dependency order, give every review comment an explicit disposition, and only call a change ready after re-checking the real state of checks and threads instead of trusting that a push or a reply worked. Use this whenever a change is being opened, split, described, updated, or readied as a pull request or merge request, including deciding how many PRs a piece of work needs, planning or syncing a stack of dependent branches, writing or refreshing a PR description, shaping commit history before requesting review, triaging review feedback, or judging whether a PR is actually mergeable. Reach for it any time work is about to leave a branch and become something someone else has to read.
zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.descriptionEn: Shape a change so it can actually be reviewed, not just merged. Decide before writing code whether the work is one pull request or a stack of them, keep the title and body describing the diff as it exists right now, not the plan you started with, group commits by concern in dependency order, give every review comment an explicit disposition, and only call a change ready after re-checking the real state of checks and threads instead of trusting that a push or a reply worked. Use this whenever a change is being opened, split, described, updated, or readied as a pull request or merge request, including deciding how many PRs a piece of work needs, planning or syncing a stack of dependent branches, writing or refreshing a PR description, shaping commit history before requesting review, triaging review feedback, or judging whether a PR is actually mergeable. Reach for it any time work is about to leave a branch and become something someone else has to read.
zaidmukaddam/skills/pr-discipline.descriptionCn: 塑造变更，以便实际上可以对其进行审查，而不仅仅是合并。在编写代码之前决定工作是一个拉取请求还是一堆请求，保留当前存在的描述差异的标题和正文，而不是您开始的计划，按依赖顺序按关注点对提交进行分组，为每个评论评论提供明确的处置，并且仅在重新检查检查和线程的真实状态后才调用更改就绪，而不是相信推送或回复有效。每当打开、拆分、描述、更新或准备作为拉取请求或合并请求进行更改时，请使用此功能，包括确定一项工作需要多少 PR，规划或同步一堆依赖分支，编写或刷新 PR 描述，在请求审查之前调整提交历史记录，对审查反馈进行分类，或判断 PR 是否实际上可合并。每当作品即将离开分支并成为其他人必须阅读的东西时，就伸手去拿它。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/ads-and-iap-mone.title: ads-and-iap-monetization
zakariaf/flutter-skills/ads-and-iap-mone.description: Enforces opt-in, rewarded-first monetization over the service seam — a rewarded view grants exactly one benefit and only on a genuine reward outcome (a sealed Rewarded/Dismissed/NoFill), earn loops capped per day against an injected Clock, the earn control preloaded and hidden unless an ad is loaded so a fresh account never dead-ends on "no ads available" (a Guideline 2.1 risk), interstitials only at a natural break under a count-and-elapsed cap owned by the service so callers stay dumb, no banner on the primary work surface, one non-consumable unlock plus Restore re-checked each launch and committed through the single write path before the UI reacts, one derived isEntitled provider as the only gate, and the entitlement restored BEFORE the ad SDK initializes so a paying user never starts it, resolves consent, or sees a tracking prompt. zakariaf/flutter-skills/app-startup-and-.description: Enforces a fixed main() cold-launch order — crash-log sink + FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError installed BEFORE any code that can throw, settings/theme read before runApp so the first frame paints correct, real infra constructed in a composition-root bootstrap() and injected via ProviderScope overrideWithValue over throwing placeholder providers, non-blocking warm-up deferred to addPostFrameCallback, exactly two error handlers with NO runZonedGuarded, ProviderException unwrapped before logging, and a WidgetsBindingObserver that flushes durable state on background/resume. zakariaf/flutter-skills/ci-pipeline-and-.title: ci-pipeline-and-gates
zakariaf/flutter-skills/ci-pipeline-and-.description: Enforces a lean GitHub Actions Flutter CI where every gate maps to one named release-blocking contract — pinned runner + subosito/flutter-action@v2 toolchain, dart format --set-exit-if-changed, flutter analyze --fatal-infos, build_runner and drift schema freshness (git diff --exit-code), flutter test --test-randomize-ordering-seed random, static import/banned-string greps that catch what runtime can't, coverage-as-report-never-a-gate with the upward-lie fixed, verify-never-bless goldens (no --update-goldens in CI), and an honest statement of what CI cannot prove (audio, real fonts, on-device behaviour). zakariaf/flutter-skills/codegen-and-tool.title: codegen-and-toolchain
zakariaf/flutter-skills/codegen-and-tool.description: Enforces a deterministic build_runner codegen discipline: run one pinned `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` pass BEFORE `flutter analyze` (never after), fence every builder with `generate_for:` globs in a per-package `build.yaml`, make one deliberate commit-vs-gitignore decision for `*.g.dart`/`*.freezed.dart`/`*.drift.dart` and back it with the matching CI gate (freshness diff if committed, codegen-first if gitignored), mirror the generated-file globs into the analyzer AND coverage excludes, pin the SDK, and never hand-edit generated output. zakariaf/flutter-skills/dart3-idioms-and.title: dart3-idioms-and-coding-standards
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dart3-idioms-and.description: Enforces which Dart 3 construct each declaration earns — sealed class + exhaustive switch with no `default:`/`case _:`, the three class modifiers (`sealed`/`final`/`abstract interface class`) and skip the rest, records as intra-layer tuples only, immutable value types (`final` fields, `const` ctor, value equality) hand-rolled when trivial and `freezed` when boilerplate dominates, explicit stable identity, total non-throwing domain functions, make-illegal-states-unrepresentable, and firm method/build/file/nesting complexity limits (the single-source-of-truth table other skills cite) — while banning `late`/`!`/`dynamic` honesty dodges. zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.title: dartdoc-conventions
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.description: Enforces Effective-Dart documentation on the public surface — a `///` doc on every public class/method/getter/field/typedef, a one-sentence standalone summary that says WHY plus units/ranges/nullability/throws/side-effects (never a restatement of the name), verb-phrase method docs, "Whether…" boolean getters, `[bracket]` cross-links, one `library;` doc per exported barrel, in-body `//` that explains why not what, and the enforced invariant restated at its enforcement point — backed by `public_member_api_docs` and `dangling_library_doc_comments` as analyzer errors. zakariaf/flutter-skills/dartdoc-conventi.descriptionCn: 在公共表面上强制执行有效的 Dart 文档 - 每个公共类/方法/getter/field/typedef 上的一个 `///` 文档，一个单句独立摘要，说明为什么加上单位/范围/可空性/抛出/副作用（从不重述名称），动词短语方法文档，“是否...”布尔 getters，“[括号]”交叉链接，一个“库；”每个导出桶的文档，体内“//”解释为什么而不是什么，以及在其执行点重述的强制不变式 - 由“public_member_api_docs”和“dangling_library_doc_comments”支持作为分析器错误。在添加或查看公共 API、通知程序/提供程序、服务接口、密封故障、值类型或准备包的 dartdoc 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.title: data-export-and-restore
zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.description: Enforces user-facing data portability in an offline-first app — backup/restore (exact, machine round-trippable) kept strictly separate from export/report (human, lossy, never a restore source); a versioned envelope carrying formatVersion, schemaVersion, appVersion, exportedAtUtc and a payload checksum so a restore refuses a file from a newer app instead of corrupting the database; restore as an all-or-nothing import into a staging database swapped in only after validation; canonical values in machine formats (integer minor units, SI integers, ISO-8601 UTC, stable ids) and never localized numerals; RFC 4180 CSV quoting plus the =/+/-/@ formula-injection escape; streaming writes published by atomic rename; the share sheet behind an injected Gateway; and an export→import→export round-trip test on a hostile fixture. Use when adding or changing export, backup, import, restore, share, or CSV/JSON/PDF output, writing an import validator or merge-vs-replace policy, or handling a picked file.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.descriptionEn: Enforces user-facing data portability in an offline-first app — backup/restore (exact, machine round-trippable) kept strictly separate from export/report (human, lossy, never a restore source); a versioned envelope carrying formatVersion, schemaVersion, appVersion, exportedAtUtc and a payload checksum so a restore refuses a file from a newer app instead of corrupting the database; restore as an all-or-nothing import into a staging database swapped in only after validation; canonical values in machine formats (integer minor units, SI integers, ISO-8601 UTC, stable ids) and never localized numerals; RFC 4180 CSV quoting plus the =/+/-/@ formula-injection escape; streaming writes published by atomic rename; the share sheet behind an injected Gateway; and an export→import→export round-trip test on a hostile fixture. Use when adding or changing export, backup, import, restore, share, or CSV/JSON/PDF output, writing an import validator or merge-vs-replace policy, or handling a picked file.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/data-export-and-.descriptionCn: 在离线优先的应用程序中强制执行面向用户的数据可移植性——备份/恢复（精确，机器可往返）与导出/报告严格分开（人工，有损，绝不是恢复源）；带有 formatVersion、schemaVersion、appVersion、exportedAtUtc 和有效负载校验和的版本化信封，因此恢复会拒绝来自较新应用程序的文件，而不是损坏数据库；作为全有或全无导入恢复到仅在验证后交换的临时数据库；机器格式的规范值（整数小单位、SI 整数、ISO-8601 UTC、稳定 ID）和从未本地化的数字； RFC 4180 CSV 引用加上 =/+/-/@ 公式注入转义；通过原子重命名发布流式写入；注入网关后面的共享表；以及对敌对装置进行导出→导入→导出往返测试。在添加或更改导出、备份、导入、恢复、共享或 CSV/JSON/PDF 输出、编写导入验证器或合并与替换策略或处理所选文件时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.title: dependency-hygiene
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.description: Enforces pubspec/lock discipline — caret ranges in pubspec.yaml with a committed pubspec.lock as the only pin, a separately-recorded SDK version string, a version-pinned very_good_analysis include (whose missing file fails default analyze, or silently drops the ruleset where warnings are non-fatal), transitive-tree auditing before adding a package, a dependency gate that refuses network/telemetry/crash/ads/heavy-transitive deps by policy, and vendoring any bus-factor-1 native plugin behind an interface into third_party/. Use when running dart pub add/get/upgrade/outdated/deps, editing pubspec.yaml or pubspec.lock, bumping the Flutter/Dart SDK, choosing or rejecting a new dependency, removing a package, or auditing what a dependency drags in.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.descriptionEn: Enforces pubspec/lock discipline — caret ranges in pubspec.yaml with a committed pubspec.lock as the only pin, a separately-recorded SDK version string, a version-pinned very_good_analysis include (whose missing file fails default analyze, or silently drops the ruleset where warnings are non-fatal), transitive-tree auditing before adding a package, a dependency gate that refuses network/telemetry/crash/ads/heavy-transitive deps by policy, and vendoring any bus-factor-1 native plugin behind an interface into third_party/. Use when running dart pub add/get/upgrade/outdated/deps, editing pubspec.yaml or pubspec.lock, bumping the Flutter/Dart SDK, choosing or rejecting a new dependency, removing a package, or auditing what a dependency drags in.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/dependency-hygie.descriptionCn: 强制执行 pubspec/lock 规则 - pubspec.yaml 中的插入符范围，以提交的 pubspec.lock 作为唯一的 pin，单独记录的 SDK 版本字符串，版本固定的 very_good_analysis 包含（其丢失的文件默认分析失败，或者默默地删除警告非致命的规则集），添加包之前的传递树审核，拒绝网络/遥测/崩溃/广告/重传递依赖的依赖门策略，并将接口后面的任何总线因子 1 本机插件供应到third_party/。在运行 dart pub add/get/upgrade/outdated/deps、编辑 pubspec.yaml 或 pubspec.lock、碰撞 Flutter/Dart SDK、选择或拒绝新依赖项、删除包或审核依赖项拖入的内容时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.title: design-system-structure
zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.description: Structures a Flutter design system as tokens→theme→modifiers→shapes with two-tier tokens (primitives named by measured value, semantic slots named by role) exposed through a ThemeExtension read via an asserting of(context); hand-authors both light and dark ColorScheme instead of ColorScheme.fromSeed, keeps every raw color/hex/Colors./Curves./Duration/BorderRadius/fontSize inside lib/theme/ behind a no-raw-values gate, collapses animation to zero under reduced motion, restores the persisted theme before first paint, bundles fonts (never google_fonts/dynamic_color), and derives each stateful meaning's supporting color last so color is never its sole signal. Use when creating or editing ThemeData/ThemeExtension/ColorScheme, adding or renaming a design token, wiring theme injection or theme-mode persistence, reaching for fromSeed/dynamic_color/google_fonts/FontVariation, structuring a theme/ or DesignSystem/ folder, or reviewing any widget that renders a color, radius, duration, or font.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.descriptionEn: Structures a Flutter design system as tokens→theme→modifiers→shapes with two-tier tokens (primitives named by measured value, semantic slots named by role) exposed through a ThemeExtension read via an asserting of(context); hand-authors both light and dark ColorScheme instead of ColorScheme.fromSeed, keeps every raw color/hex/Colors./Curves./Duration/BorderRadius/fontSize inside lib/theme/ behind a no-raw-values gate, collapses animation to zero under reduced motion, restores the persisted theme before first paint, bundles fonts (never google_fonts/dynamic_color), and derives each stateful meaning's supporting color last so color is never its sole signal. Use when creating or editing ThemeData/ThemeExtension/ColorScheme, adding or renaming a design token, wiring theme injection or theme-mode persistence, reaching for fromSeed/dynamic_color/google_fonts/FontVariation, structuring a theme/ or DesignSystem/ folder, or reviewing any widget that renders a color, radius, duration, or font.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/design-system-st.descriptionCn: 将 Flutter 设计系统构造为令牌→主题→修饰符→形状，其中具有两层令牌（由测量值命名的基元，由角色命名的语义槽），通过（上下文）的断言读取的 ThemeExtension 公开；手工创作浅色和深色 ColorScheme 而不是 ColorScheme.fromSeed，将每个原始颜色/hex/Colors./Curves./Duration/BorderRadius/fontSize 保留在 lib/theme/ 内的无原始值门后面，在减少运动下将动画折叠为零，在第一次绘制之前恢复持久主题，捆绑字体（从不 google_fonts/dynamic_color），并派生每个有状态含义的支持颜色放在最后，因此颜色永远不是其唯一的信号。在创建或编辑 ThemeData/ThemeExtension/ColorScheme、添加或重命名设计令牌、连接主题注入或主题模式持久性、访问 fromSeed/dynamic_color/google_fonts/FontVariation、构造 theme/ 或 DesignSystem/ 文件夹或查看呈现颜色、半径、持续时间或字体的任何小部件时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.title: error-handling-typed-results
zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.description: Enforces a typed-error spine — a hand-rolled sealed Result<T,F> plus one per-boundary sealed Failure carrying a stable code and typed params (never a localized string), returned instead of thrown; recoverable failures are values, only bugs throw. Convert-at-boundary catches narrowly with an on-clause and logs the original error+stack BEFORE returning a typed Failure; call sites switch exhaustively with no default:; the taxonomy of what the global error net (FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError, installed by app-startup-and-bootstrap) routes into, plus Isolate.run re-wrapping; mechanism selection (Error vs assert vs Exception vs sealed outcome) and @useResult; and a never-lose-data layer (one-transaction-per-mutation, debounced autosave drafts, optimistic soft-delete/Undo). Use when writing result.dart/failures.dart, a try/catch or sealed-switch default:, wiring bootstrap handlers, a repository/service/DAO boundary, or transactions, drafts, or soft-delete/Undo.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.descriptionEn: Enforces a typed-error spine — a hand-rolled sealed Result<T,F> plus one per-boundary sealed Failure carrying a stable code and typed params (never a localized string), returned instead of thrown; recoverable failures are values, only bugs throw. Convert-at-boundary catches narrowly with an on-clause and logs the original error+stack BEFORE returning a typed Failure; call sites switch exhaustively with no default:; the taxonomy of what the global error net (FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError, installed by app-startup-and-bootstrap) routes into, plus Isolate.run re-wrapping; mechanism selection (Error vs assert vs Exception vs sealed outcome) and @useResult; and a never-lose-data layer (one-transaction-per-mutation, debounced autosave drafts, optimistic soft-delete/Undo). Use when writing result.dart/failures.dart, a try/catch or sealed-switch default:, wiring bootstrap handlers, a repository/service/DAO boundary, or transactions, drafts, or soft-delete/Undo.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/error-handling-t.descriptionCn: 强制执行类型化错误脊柱 - 一个手工滚动的密封 Result<T,F> 加上一个每个边界密封的 Failure，携带稳定代码和类型化参数（绝不是本地化字符串），返回而不是抛出；可恢复的故障是值，只有错误才会抛出。 Convert-at-boundary 使用 on 子句捕获并在返回类型化失败之前记录原始错误+堆栈；调用站点完全切换，没有默认值：；全局错误网（FlutterError.onError + PlatformDispatcher.onError，由 app-startup-and-bootstrap 安装）路由到的分类，加上 Isolate.run 重新包装；机制选择（错误、断言、异常、密封结果）和@useResult；以及永不丢失数据层（每个突变一个事务、去抖自动保存草稿、乐观软删除/撤消）。在编写 result.dart/failures.dart、try/catch 或密封开关默认值时使用：连接引导处理程序、存储库/服务/DAO 边界或事务、草稿或软删除/撤消。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.title: flutter-architecture
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.description: Enforces a right-sized feature-first layered MVVM Flutter architecture — features are folders and cross-cutting foundations become packages only when a compile wall earns it, a strict downward-only dependency DAG, dumb Views over one Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel per feature, repositories as the single source of truth and single write path returning immutable domain values, abstractions only where something genuinely can't run in a test, and Riverpod 3.x as the one context-free DI+state mechanism (no get_it/injectable/package:provider container). Use when creating a Flutter feature or file, deciding folder-vs-package or where a class belongs, naming a Screen/Notifier/Repository/Service, wiring providers or a composition-root/bootstrap.dart, adding a use-case/domain layer, resisting over-engineering on a small app, or reviewing whether a change respects the layer boundaries.

Use when creating a Flutter feature or file, deciding folder-vs-package or where a class belongs, naming a Screen/Notifier/Repository/Service, wiring providers or a composition-root/bootstrap.dart, adding a use-case/domain layer, resisting over-engineering on a small app, or reviewing whether a change respects the layer boundaries.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-architec.descriptionCn: 强制实施大小合适的功能优先分层 MVVM Flutter 架构 - 功能是文件夹，横切基础只有在编译墙获得它时才成为包，严格的向下依赖 DAG，每个功能一个 Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel 上的哑视图，存储库作为单一事实来源和返回不可变域值的单一写入路径，仅在测试中真正无法运行的地方进行抽象，以及 Riverpod 3.x 作为一个上下文无关的DI+状态机制（无 get_it/injectable/package:provider 容器）。在创建 Flutter 功能或文件、决定文件夹与包或类所属位置、命名 Screen/Notifier/Repository/Service、连接提供程序或合成根/bootstrap.dart、添加用例/域层、抵制小型应用程序上的过度工程或检查更改是否尊重层边界时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-conventi.title: flutter-conventions-index
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-conventi.description: The repo front-door for a Flutter/Dart app — the cross-cutting house rules (feature-first layered MVVM, immutable state with a single write path, Riverpod 3.x for state + DI, typed Result/Failure errors, dumb widgets, injected side effects, complexity limits) plus a routing table that sends each task to its deep-dive skill and a recommended feature build order. Use at the start of any Flutter/Dart work, before writing or reviewing a feature, when deciding which layer or package code belongs in, when unsure which skill governs a task (architecture, state, widgets, persistence, testing, i18n, design), or when onboarding to the conventions.

zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-performa.title: flutter-performance
zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-performa.description: Enforces Flutter runtime performance — const subtrees, minimal rebuild scope via ref.watch(select), lazy ListView/GridView builders and slivers, sized image decode (cacheWidth/ResizeImage), heavy work off the UI isolate via compute/Isolate, surgical RepaintBoundary, dispose everything, and measurement in profile mode on a floor device. zakariaf/flutter-skills/flutter-performa.descriptionCn: 强制 Flutter 运行时性能 - const 子树、通过 ref.watch(select) 最小化重建范围、惰性 ListView/GridView 构建器和条子、大小图像解码 (cacheWidth/ResizeImage)、通过计算/隔离进行 UI 隔离的繁重工作、外科手术式 RepaintBoundary、处理所有内容以及在地面设备上以配置文件模式进行测量。在优化 UI、诊断卡顿或丢帧、调整长列表或图像、检查重建/重绘范围或任务提到 const、select、ListView.builder、cacheWidth、compute、RepaintBoundary、AnimatedBuilder、DevTools、光栅线程或 60/120fps 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/forms-and-input.title: forms-and-input
zakariaf/flutter-skills/forms-and-input.description: Enforces Form + GlobalKey<FormState> with TextFormField whose sync validator returns a localized String? (never a hardcoded literal), AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction, async availability checks moved OUT of the sync validator into a debounced Riverpod Notifier that surfaces errors through state, FocusNode/TextInputAction/onFieldSubmitted traversal, keyboardType/textCapitalization/autofillHints/TextInputFormatter, mandatory TextEditingController/FocusNode disposal, submit-enabled derived from validity (not stored), and scoped rebuilds so a keystroke never rebuilds the whole form. zakariaf/flutter-skills/forms-and-input.descriptionCn: 强制 Form + GlobalKey<FormState> 与 TextFormField 同步验证器返回本地化字符串？ （绝不是硬编码文字）、AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction、异步可用性检查从同步验证器移出到去抖的 Riverpod 通知程序中，该通知程序通过状态显示错误、FocusNode/TextInputAction/onFieldSubscribed 遍历、keyboardType/textCapitalization/autofillHints/TextInputFormatter、强制 TextEditingController/FocusNode 处置、从有效性派生的启用提交（未存储）以及作用域重建，因此击键永远不会发生重建整个形式。在构建 Form、TextFormField 或 FormField 时使用；连接同步或异步验证；管理 FocusNode、焦点遍历、自动对焦、TextInputAction、onFieldSubscribed 或 onEditingComplete；设置keyboardType、autofillHints、textCapitalization 或InputFormatter；处置 TextEditingController/FocusNode；启用/禁用提交按钮；或在提交时处理避免键盘操作。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/i18n-rtl-l10n.title: i18n-rtl-l10n
zakariaf/flutter-skills/i18n-rtl-l10n.description: Enforces the gen-l10n/ARB localization contract: every user-facing string routed through AppLocalizations from a template app_en.arb with key + placeholder parity across locales, nullable-getter:false so a missing key is a compile error, ICU plural/select over string concatenation, Directional-only geometry (EdgeInsetsDirectional, AlignmentDirectional, TextAlign.start, Icons.adaptive) for correct-by-construction RTL, one FSI/PDI bidi-isolation helper for mixed-script runs, per-locale NumberFormat with a pinned numbering system fed to chrome and canvas alike, canonical UTC-epoch + ASCII storage with calendar/numeral projection only at render, and normalize-to-ASCII before any numeric parse. Use when adding or translating an ARB key, building an RTL screen, formatting or parsing dates/numbers/numerals, wiring l10n.yaml, AppLocalizations, or MaterialApp localization delegates, isolating technical IDs like an account or order reference, or touching app_*.arb.

zakariaf/flutter-skills/i18n-rtl-l10n.descriptionCn: 强制执行 gen-l10n/ARB 本地化合同：每个面向用户的字符串从模板 app_en.arb 通过 AppLocalizations 路由，并具有跨语言环境的键 + 占位符奇偶校验，nullable-getter:false 因此缺少键是编译错误，ICU 复数/选择字符串连接，仅限方向几何（EdgeInsetsDirectional、AlignmentDirectional、TextAlign.start、Icons.adaptive）以进行正确构建RTL，一个用于混合脚本运行的 FSI/PDI 双向隔离帮助程序，每个区域设置的 NumberFormat 以及馈送到 chrome 和 canvas 等的固定编号系统，规范的 UTC 纪元 + ASCII 存储，仅在渲染时进行日历/数字投影，并在任何数字解析之前标准化为 ASCII。在添加或翻译 ARB 密钥、构建 RTL 屏幕、格式化或解析日期/数字/数字、连接 l10n.yaml、AppLocalizations 或 MaterialApp 本地化委托、隔离帐户或订单引用等技术 ID 或触摸 app_*.arb 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/lint-and-style-c.title: lint-and-style-config
zakariaf/flutter-skills/lint-and-style-c.description: Enforces a strict analysis_options.yaml built on very_good_analysis with strict-casts/strict-raw-types, a fixed set of silence-producing bug classes promoted to error (unawaited_futures, discarded_futures, empty_catches, use_build_context_synchronously, cancel_subscriptions, close_sinks, avoid_dynamic_calls, exhaustive_cases, avoid_print), dart format as the sole whitespace authority, generated-file excludes mirrored to coverage, and line-scoped-only suppression discipline; teaches the version-pinned-include trap (a missing include silently disables all rules), the errors-only-re-ranks-vs-linter-enables mechanic, and the sealed-switch analyze-vs-compile gap. zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.title: motion-and-haptics
zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.description: Enforces designed interaction feedback instead of the framework default — every committing interaction acknowledged in the same frame, motion that decorates state but never IS the state (the end state is identical with animations off), a named catalog of moments each declaring its trigger, duration role, haptic slot and reduced-motion fallback at design time, haptics as a HapticTheme event-to-intensity map fired exactly once on the commit frame (never per animation frame, never per coalesced input, never heavyImpact for an error) behind one central toggle, every animation interruptible so a tap resolves it to its end state, a bounded celebration that plays once and never loops or blocks input, an explicit stop condition on every repeating animation (off-route, backgrounded, reduced motion), and feedback on more than one channel so haptics and sound survive reduced motion. zakariaf/flutter-skills/motion-and-hapti.descriptionCn: 强制执行设计的交互反馈而不是框架默认值 - 每个在同一帧中确认的提交交互、装饰状态但绝不是状态的运动（最终状态与动画关闭相同）、每个时刻的命名目录，每个时刻都在设计时声明其触发器、持续时间角色、触觉槽和简化运动后备，触觉作为 HapticTheme 事件到强度映射在提交帧上仅触发一次（从不按动画帧，从不按合并输入，从不重影响）一个中央开关后面的每个动画都可以中断，这样点击就可以将其解决为最终状态，一种播放一次并且从不循环或阻止输入的有限庆祝，每个重复动画的明确停止条件（偏离路线，背景，减少运动），以及多个通道的反馈，以便触觉和声音在减少的运动中幸存。在添加或调整动画、成功或错误状态、触觉、庆祝或屏幕转换时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/persistence-drif.title: persistence-drift
zakariaf/flutter-skills/persistence-drif.description: Governs the on-device Drift/SQLite data layer: package:drift and package:sqlite3 confined to lib/data/ behind DAOs that map rows to immutable value objects (no Drift symbol leaks past the repository), invariants pushed into the schema (STRICT tables, CHECK/FK/partial-UNIQUE indexes), foreign_keys/WAL pragmas re-asserted idempotently in beforeOpen, one db.transaction per mutation, persist-before-publish, every query awaited, canonical integer storage, derived state recomputed-on-read never stored, scoped .watch streams, keyset (seek) pagination not OFFSET, and WAL-safe backups (checkpoint + VACUUM INTO, verify-by-reopen, never File.copy a live WAL DB). zakariaf/flutter-skills/persistence-drif.descriptionCn: 管理设备上的 Drift/SQLite 数据层：package:drift 和 package:sqlite3 仅限于将行映射到不可变值对象的 DAO 后面的 lib/data/（没有 Drift 符号通过存储库泄漏）、推入模式的不变量（STRICT 表、CHECK/FK/partial-UNIQUE 索引）、foreign_keys/WAL pragmas 在 beforeOpen 中幂等地重新断言，每个 db.transaction突变、发布前持久化、等待每个查询、规范整数存储、读取时重新计算的派生状态从未存储、作用域 .watch 流、键集（查找）分页而不是 OFFSET 以及 WAL 安全备份（检查点 + VACUUM INTO、通过重新打开进行验证、从不 File.copy 实时 WAL DB）。在定义或更改 Drift Table、Companion、DAO、索引或 CHECK 时使用；编写存储库事务或作用域监视提供程序；连接连接/beforeOpen pragmas；添加 SQLCipher；建立或验证备份；或查看数据层差异。迁移及其测试存在于运行迁移中。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-goldens-reba.title: run-goldens-rebaseline
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-goldens-reba.description: Runs the golden re-baselining ritual — the one sanctioned way committed reference images are overwritten. zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-goldens-reba.descriptionCn: 运行黄金重新基线仪式 - 覆盖提交的参考图像的一种认可方式。强制执行顺序：首先对非金色几何体、对比度和 a11y 测试进行着陆和绿化，仅在生成提交图像的固定祝福环境中重新设置基线，使用 loadAppFonts()，这样通过“flutter test --update-goldens --tags Golden”，在 Ahem 中不会渲染任何内容（切勿在 CI 中，切勿将红色管道设为绿色），然后通过肉眼检查每个更改的 PNG，删除由重命名或删除的测试留下的孤儿，将图像着陆为他们自己的提交命名了他们移动的原因，并通过在没有标志的情况下重新运行套件来证明这一点。手动的、有副作用的工作流程。当故意的视觉更改破坏 matchesGoldenFile 时、添加或重命名黄金测试时或有人使用 --update-goldens 时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.title: run-migration
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.description: Runs the forward-only Drift/SQLite schema-migration ritual — the most dangerous deterministic operation in an offline-first app: a bad migration silently destroys on-device rows that exist nowhere else. Enforces the exact ordered sequence: take a pre-migration file snapshot before the database is opened, bump schemaVersion by exactly one, write an append-only stepByStep forward step (never edit a shipped step, never write a down migration), commit the drift_dev make-migrations schema snapshot, regenerate, then prove it with tests covering every from→to path (incl. multi-version jumps), a write-at-v(n)/read-at-v(n+1) content test, PRAGMA integrity_check + foreign_key_check, and a forced mid-migration throw that restores the snapshot. Manual, side-effecting workflow. Use when adding or altering a Drift table, column, index, or CHECK; bumping schemaVersion; editing onUpgrade/stepByStep; or writing migration tests.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.descriptionEn: Runs the forward-only Drift/SQLite schema-migration ritual — the most dangerous deterministic operation in an offline-first app: a bad migration silently destroys on-device rows that exist nowhere else. Enforces the exact ordered sequence: take a pre-migration file snapshot before the database is opened, bump schemaVersion by exactly one, write an append-only stepByStep forward step (never edit a shipped step, never write a down migration), commit the drift_dev make-migrations schema snapshot, regenerate, then prove it with tests covering every from→to path (incl. multi-version jumps), a write-at-v(n)/read-at-v(n+1) content test, PRAGMA integrity_check + foreign_key_check, and a forced mid-migration throw that restores the snapshot. Manual, side-effecting workflow. Use when adding or altering a Drift table, column, index, or CHECK; bumping schemaVersion; editing onUpgrade/stepByStep; or writing migration tests.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/run-migration.descriptionCn: 运行只进的 Drift/SQLite 模式迁移仪式——离线优先应用程序中最危险的确定性操作：错误的迁移会默默地破坏设备上不存在于其他地方的行。强制执行精确的排序顺序：在打开数据库之前拍摄预迁移文件快照，将 schemaVersion 精确提高 1，编写仅追加的逐步前进步骤（从不编辑已发布的步骤，从不编写向下迁移），提交drift_dev make-migrations 架构快照，重新生成，然后通过覆盖每个 from→to 路径（包括多版本跳转）的测试来证明它，write-at-v(n)/read-at-v(n+1) 内容测试、PRAGMAintegrity_check +foreign_key_check，以及恢复快照的强制迁移中期抛出。手动的、有副作用的工作流程。添加或更改 Drift 表、列、索引或 CHECK 时使用；碰撞 schemaVersion；编辑 onUpgrade/stepByStep；或编写迁移测试。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/scaffold-feature.title: scaffold-feature-module
zakariaf/flutter-skills/scaffold-feature.description: Stands up one navigable feature the same way every time — a fixed lib/features/<feature>/presentation/ folder (dumb View + one 1:1 Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel + widgets/ + scoped <feature>_providers.dart), downward-only dependencies with no cross-feature imports, reactive reads as scoped StreamProviders over a repository .watch(), every mutation through one repository single-write-path method, typed Result/Failure surfaced as AsyncValue, a typed go_router route carrying identity in path params, ARB parity across locales, family+autoDispose keying, and EdgeInsetsDirectional-only geometry. Use when adding a screen, tab, or feature folder; wiring a feature Notifier/ViewModel or a scoped stream provider; registering a route; adding ARB keys for a new screen; splitting an over-grown feature; or adding a persisted record its View reads.

zakariaf/flutter-skills/scaffold-feature.descriptionCn: 每次都以相同的方式建立一个可导航功能 - 一个固定的 lib/features/<feature>/presentation/ 文件夹（哑视图 + 一个 1:1 Notifier/AsyncNotifier ViewModel + widgets/ + 作用域 <feature>_providers.dart），仅向下依赖，没有跨功能导入，通过存储库 .watch() 作为作用域 StreamProvider 进行反应性读取，通过一个存储库单写入路径方法进行的每个突变，类型为结果/失败AsyncValue，一个类型化的 go_router 路由，在路径参数中携带身份、跨区域设置的 ARB 奇偶校验、family+autoDispose 键控和仅限 EdgeInsetsDirectional 的几何图形。添加屏幕、选项卡或功能文件夹时使用；连接功能通知程序/视图模型或范围流提供程序；注册路线；为新屏幕添加 ARB 键；分割过度增长的特征；或添加其视图读取的持久记录。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.title: seeded-determinism-and-golden-vectors
zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.description: Enforces reproducible derived content — output every device must compute identically from a key, with no server. The key is injected, never read from a clock; a calendar-day key is a civil date, not an instant, and one day definition serves every comparison; the seed is a specified hash plus a mix step feeding a PRNG you own, never `dart:math`'s `Random`; entropy has exactly one source, so no `DateTime.now()`, no ambient `Random()`, no ordering by `identityHashCode`; content is regenerated from (key, generatorVersion) rather than stored; a shipped generator is frozen and an improvement is a versioned cutover, never an in-place edit that rewrites history; and it is pinned by a committed golden-vector table of fingerprints from an independent oracle, regenerated only by a reviewed command CI verifies but never blesses. Use when generating content from a seed or date, writing or regenerating golden vectors, versioning a generator, or debugging output that differs between devices or runs.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.descriptionEn: Enforces reproducible derived content — output every device must compute identically from a key, with no server. The key is injected, never read from a clock; a calendar-day key is a civil date, not an instant, and one day definition serves every comparison; the seed is a specified hash plus a mix step feeding a PRNG you own, never `dart:math`'s `Random`; entropy has exactly one source, so no `DateTime.now()`, no ambient `Random()`, no ordering by `identityHashCode`; content is regenerated from (key, generatorVersion) rather than stored; a shipped generator is frozen and an improvement is a versioned cutover, never an in-place edit that rewrites history; and it is pinned by a committed golden-vector table of fingerprints from an independent oracle, regenerated only by a reviewed command CI verifies but never blesses. Use when generating content from a seed or date, writing or regenerating golden vectors, versioning a generator, or debugging output that differs between devices or runs.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/seeded-determini.descriptionCn: 强制执行可复制的派生内容 - 每个设备的输出必须根据密钥进行相同的计算，无需服务器。密钥被注入，永远不会从时钟读取；日历日键是一个民用日期，而不是一个瞬间，一天的定义适用于所有比较；种子是指定的哈希加上混合步骤，提供您拥有的 PRNG，而不是“dart:math”的“Random”；熵只有一个来源，因此没有“DateTime.now()”，没有环境“Random()”，没有“identityHashCode”排序；内容是从（key，generatorVersion）重新生成而不是存储；发货的生成器被冻结，改进是版本化的切换，而不是重写历史的就地编辑；它由来自独立预言机的承诺指纹黄金向量表固定，仅由 CI 验证但从不祝福的经过审查的命令重新生成。在从种子或日期生成内容、编写或重新生成黄金向量、对生成器进行版本控制或调试设备或运行之间不同的输出时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/service-boundary.title: service-boundary-and-native
zakariaf/flutter-skills/service-boundary.description: Wires every side effect and native channel as an injectable interface behind a Provider that throws UnimplementedError until the composition root overrides it, with one live impl per flavor, value-typed signatures returning typed results, hand-written contract-honouring fakes over mocks, MethodChannel quarantined to one lib/native/ directory, and versioned cross-language contracts edited on both sides in one commit. Use when adding or changing a ShareService/AnalyticsService/RemoteConfigService or any side-effect port, injecting a Clock (package:clock) via clockProvider, a MethodChannel/platform channel or native widget bridge, a flavor entrypoint (main_*.dart) or per-flavor provider override, a shared-file/JSON contract mirrored in Kotlin/Swift, replacing a stray DateTime.now() or direct SDK call inside a widget/notifier/repository, or wiring a fake via ProviderScope(overrides:) in tests.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/service-boundary.descriptionEn: Wires every side effect and native channel as an injectable interface behind a Provider that throws UnimplementedError until the composition root overrides it, with one live impl per flavor, value-typed signatures returning typed results, hand-written contract-honouring fakes over mocks, MethodChannel quarantined to one lib/native/ directory, and versioned cross-language contracts edited on both sides in one commit. zakariaf/flutter-skills/service-boundary.descriptionCn: 将每个副作用和本机通道连接为 Provider 后面的可注入接口，抛出 UnimplementedError 直到组合根覆盖它，每种风格有一个实时 impl，返回类型化结果的值类型签名，通过模拟手写的合同兑现伪造，隔离到一个 lib/native/ 目录的 MethodChannel 以及在一次提交中在双方编辑的版本化跨语言合同。添加或更改 ShareService/AnalyticsService/RemoteConfigService 或任何副作用端口、通过 ClockProvider 注入时钟（包：时钟）、MethodChannel/平台通道或本机小部件桥、风格入口点 (main_*.dart) 或每个风格提供程序覆盖、Kotlin/Swift 中镜像的共享文件/JSON 合约、替换小部件/通知程序/存储库内的杂散 DateTime.now() 或直接 SDK 调用，或通过连接伪造时使用测试中的 ProviderScope(overrides:) 。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/state-management.title: state-management-riverpod
zakariaf/flutter-skills/state-management.description: Enforces feature state as one Notifier/AsyncNotifier/StreamNotifier ViewModel over an immutable state value with value equality, private mutable state mutated only through intent methods, derive-don't-store, a single write path through a repository, and unidirectional data flow; Riverpod 3.x is DI (providers-as-collaborators, ProviderScope overrides per flavor, throwing seams), reads split ref.watch/.select for display vs ref.read(p.notifier) in callbacks vs ref.listen for side effects, async modeled as AsyncValue, per-entity state family-keyed + autoDispose, and stale-closure captures / legacy StateProvider-StateNotifierProvider-ChangeNotifierProvider / get_it / package:provider are banned. Use when adding state to a screen, writing a feature controller/ViewModel, wiring providers or DI, deriving a read model from a stream, or reviewing rebuild/state-leak/disposal/write-path issues.

Use when adding state to a screen, writing a feature controller/ViewModel, wiring providers or DI, deriving a read model from a stream, or reviewing rebuild/state-leak/disposal/write-path issues.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/state-management.descriptionCn: 将功能状态强制为一个 Notifier/AsyncNotifier/StreamNotifier ViewModel，覆盖具有值相等的不可变状态值、仅通过意图方法、派生不存储、通过存储库的单个写入路径和单向数据流改变的私有可变状态； Riverpod 3.x 是 DI（providers-as-collaborators，ProviderScope 覆盖每个风格，抛出接缝），读取 split ref.watch/.select 进行显示，回调中的 ref.read(p.notifier) 与 ref.listen 进行副作用，异步建模为 AsyncValue，每个实体状态系列键控 + autoDispose，以及过时闭包捕获 / 遗留 StateProvider-StateNotifierProvider-ChangeNotifierProvider / get_it / package:provider 被禁止。在向屏幕添加状态、编写功能控制器/ViewModel、连接提供程序或 DI、从流中派生读取模型或检查重建/状态泄漏/处置/写入路径问题时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/testing-strategy.title: testing-strategy
zakariaf/flutter-skills/testing-strategy.description: Enforces test doctrine where shape follows code not the pyramid: pushes logic into Flutter-free packages tested with pure package:test and an injected Clock; asserts invariants with seeded fuzz tests against an independent oracle plus round-trip and rounding goldens; prefers bare-implements fakes over mocktail for code you own; tests the data layer against a real NativeDatabase.memory Drift engine, never a mocked DAO; drives Notifiers headlessly with ProviderContainer overrides; guards one end-to-end acceptance gate and a runtime invariant tripwire; floors coverage on unrecoverable-bug files not a global percentage; and fixes the coverage-lies-upward gap. Use when writing tests under test/ or integration_test/, choosing unit vs widget vs integration, adding a fuzz or round-trip property, wiring a fake or ProviderContainer test, gating coverage, or triaging a flaky-suite failure.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/testing-strategy.descriptionEn: Enforces test doctrine where shape follows code not the pyramid: pushes logic into Flutter-free packages tested with pure package:test and an injected Clock; asserts invariants with seeded fuzz tests against an independent oracle plus round-trip and rounding goldens; prefers bare-implements fakes over mocktail for code you own; tests the data layer against a real NativeDatabase.memory Drift engine, never a mocked DAO; drives Notifiers headlessly with ProviderContainer overrides; guards one end-to-end acceptance gate and a runtime invariant tripwire; floors coverage on unrecoverable-bug files not a global percentage; and fixes the coverage-lies-upward gap. Use when writing tests under test/ or integration_test/, choosing unit vs widget vs integration, adding a fuzz or round-trip property, wiring a fake or ProviderContainer test, gating coverage, or triaging a flaky-suite failure.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/testing-strategy.descriptionCn: 强制执行测试原则，其中形状遵循代码而不是金字塔：将逻辑推入使用纯包测试的无颤振包：测试和注入的时钟；通过针对独立预言机的种子模糊测试以及往返和舍入黄金来断言不变量；对于您拥有的代码，更喜欢裸机假货而不是无模型；针对真实的 NativeDatabase.memory Drift 引擎测试数据层，而不是模拟的 DAO；通过 ProviderContainer 覆盖无头驱动通知程序；保护一个端到端的接受门和一个运行时不变的绊线；不可恢复错误文件的覆盖率不是全局百分比；并修复覆盖范围向上的差距。在 test/ 或 Integration_test/ 下编写测试、选择单元、小部件与集成、添加模糊或往返属性、连接虚假或 ProviderContainer 测试、控制覆盖范围或对片状套件故障进行分类时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/ui-states-and-fe.title: ui-states-and-feedback
zakariaf/flutter-skills/ui-states-and-fe.description: Enforces the non-happy paths every screen owes the user — loading/empty/error/content resolved in ONE switch over an AsyncValue or sealed view state, never an isLoading+error+data bool triple; a delayed skeleton shaped like the result instead of a spinner that flashes; a refresh that keeps stale content on screen; "nothing yet" distinguished from "nothing matches this filter", each with its own action; error text from a typed Failure code (never e.toString()) plus a retry that invalidates the provider; the surface ladder inline, snackbar, banner, dialog, with a modal earned only by a decision that must resolve now; soft-delete + Undo over a confirmation; showDialog's null dismissal handled as its own outcome; ScaffoldMessenger captured before an await; and announcements for eye-only changes. Use when writing loading, empty, error, or offline UI, calling AsyncValue.when, showDialog, showModalBottomSheet, showSnackBar or showMaterialBanner, or adding a confirmation, Undo, or retry.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/ui-states-and-fe.descriptionEn: Enforces the non-happy paths every screen owes the user — loading/empty/error/content resolved in ONE switch over an AsyncValue or sealed view state, never an isLoading+error+data bool triple; a delayed skeleton shaped like the result instead of a spinner that flashes; a refresh that keeps stale content on screen; "nothing yet" distinguished from "nothing matches this filter", each with its own action; error text from a typed Failure code (never e.toString()) plus a retry that invalidates the provider; the surface ladder inline, snackbar, banner, dialog, with a modal earned only by a decision that must resolve now; soft-delete + Undo over a confirmation; showDialog's null dismissal handled as its own outcome; ScaffoldMessenger captured before an await; and announcements for eye-only changes. Use when writing loading, empty, error, or offline UI, calling AsyncValue.when, showDialog, showModalBottomSheet, showSnackBar or showMaterialBanner, or adding a confirmation, Undo, or retry.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/ui-states-and-fe.descriptionCn: 强制每个屏幕都属于用户的不愉快路径 - 在 AsyncValue 或密封视图状态的一次切换中解决加载/清空/错误/内容，而不是 isLoading+error+data bool 三元组；一个像结果一样的延迟骨架，而不是一个闪烁的旋转器；将过时的内容保留在屏幕上的刷新； “还没有”与“没有与此过滤器匹配的内容”不同，每个都有自己的操作；来自键入的失败代码（绝不是 e.toString()）的错误文本加上使提供程序无效的重试；表面梯子内联，小吃栏，横幅，对话框，只有通过现在必须解决的决定才能获得的模式；软删除+撤消确认； showDialog 的 null 解雇作为其自己的结果处理； ScaffoldMessenger 在等待之前捕获；以及仅眼睛可见的更改的公告。在编写加载、空、错误或离线 UI、调用 AsyncValue.when、showDialog、showModalBottomSheet、showSnackBar 或 showMaterialBanner，或添加确认、撤消或重试时使用。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/value-objects-mo.title: value-objects-money-and-units
zakariaf/flutter-skills/value-objects-mo.description: Enforces a pure-Dart value-object core that stores every quantity canonically — money as integer minor units keyed to each currency's real ISO-4217 exponent (never *100), physical amounts as SI whole units, timestamps as UTC — and converts only at the presentation edge; forbids double/num money, cross-currency arithmetic, and defaulting an unknown currency to two decimals; routes every division of money through one largest-remainder allocate() primitive so parts always sum to the whole to the exact minor unit; derives totals instead of storing them, links entities by stable id, and injects a Clock instead of DateTime.now. Use when defining or changing Money, Currency, or a unit value object; parsing or formatting an amount; splitting, prorating, discounting, tax/tip, or distributing money; adding a currency or FX rate; converting quantities; or fixing float-money, hardcoded-100, cross-currency, off-by-a-cent, or stored-total-drift bugs.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/value-objects-mo.descriptionEn: Enforces a pure-Dart value-object core that stores every quantity canonically — money as integer minor units keyed to each currency's real ISO-4217 exponent (never *100), physical amounts as SI whole units, timestamps as UTC — and converts only at the presentation edge; forbids double/num money, cross-currency arithmetic, and defaulting an unknown currency to two decimals; routes every division of money through one largest-remainder allocate() primitive so parts always sum to the whole to the exact minor unit; derives totals instead of storing them, links entities by stable id, and injects a Clock instead of DateTime.now. Use when defining or changing Money, Currency, or a unit value object; parsing or formatting an amount; splitting, prorating, discounting, tax/tip, or distributing money; adding a currency or FX rate; converting quantities; or fixing float-money, hardcoded-100, cross-currency, off-by-a-cent, or stored-total-drift bugs.
zakariaf/flutter-skills/value-objects-mo.descriptionCn: 强制实施纯 Dart 价值对象核心，以规范方式存储每个数量 - 货币作为整数小单位，与每种货币的真实 ISO-4217 指数（从不 *100）相匹配，物理金额作为 SI 整体单位，时间戳作为 UTC - 并且仅在呈现边缘进行转换；禁止 double/num 货币、跨货币算术以及将未知货币默认为小数点后两位；通过一个最大余数 allocate() 原语来路由每一部分的资金，因此各部分的总和与整体的总和总是精确到较小的单位；导出总计而不是存储它们，通过稳定 ID 链接实体，并注入 Clock 而不是 DateTime.now。在定义或更改货币、货币或单位价值对象时使用；解析或格式化金额；分割、按比例分配、折扣、税收/小费或分配金钱；添加货币或外汇汇率；转换数量；或修复浮动货币、硬编码 100、交叉货币、差一分或存储总漂移错误。

zakariaf/flutter-skills/widget-compositi.title: widget-composition

Use when user says "deploy template", "install template", or asks to deploy any well-known service, database, or self-hosted app. Common triggers include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, SurrealDB, PocketBase, WordPress, Ghost, Halo, n8n, Logto, Umami, Uptime Kuma, Vaultwarden, Prometheus, RSSHub, Miniflux, TTRSS, Memos, AFFiNE, Linkding, Slash, Bytebase, SQL Chat, ApiCat, OpenClaw, and any other open-source service the user wants to deploy to Zeabur.
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-template-depl.descriptionEn: Use when deploying Zeabur templates or common services/databases via CLI. Use when user says "deploy template", "install template", or asks to deploy any well-known service, database, or self-hosted app. Common triggers include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, SurrealDB, PocketBase, WordPress, Ghost, Halo, n8n, Logto, Umami, Uptime Kuma, Vaultwarden, Prometheus, RSSHub, Miniflux, TTRSS, Memos, AFFiNE, Linkding, Slash, Bytebase, SQL Chat, ApiCat, OpenClaw, and any other open-source service the user wants to deploy to Zeabur.
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-template-depl.descriptionCn: 通过 CLI 部署 Zeabur 模板或通用服务/数据库时使用。当用户说“部署模板”、“安装模板”或要求部署任何众所周知的服务、数据库或自托管应用程序时使用。常见触发器包括 MongoDB、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Redis、MinIO、SurrealDB、PocketBase、WordPress、Ghost、Halo、n8n、Logto、Umami、Uptime Kuma、Vaultwarden、Prometheus、RSSHub、Miniflux、TTRSS、Memos、AFFiNE、Linkding、Slash、Bytebase、SQL Chat、ApiCat、OpenClaw 以及用户想要部署到 Zeabur 的任何其他开源服务。

zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-template-publ.title: zeabur-template-publish
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-template-publ.description: Use when publishing or updating a Zeabur template to the marketplace. Use when user says "publish template", "update template online", "push template to Zeabur", or "create template on Zeabur". Do NOT use for deploying templates (use zeabur-template-deploy instead). Do NOT use for editing template YAML (use zeabur-template instead).
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-template-publ.descriptionEn: Use when publishing or updating a Zeabur template to the marketplace. Use when user says "publish template", "update template online", "push template to Zeabur", or "create template on Zeabur". Do NOT use for deploying templates (use zeabur-template-deploy instead). Do NOT use for editing template YAML (use zeabur-template instead).
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-template-publ.descriptionCn: 在向市场发布或更新 Zeabur 模板时使用。当用户说“发布模板”、“在线更新模板”、“将模板推送到 Zeabur”或“在 Zeabur 上创建模板”时使用。请勿用于部署模板（请改用 zeabur-template-deploy）。请勿用于编辑模板 YAML（请改用 zeabur-template）。

zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-update-servic.title: zeabur-update-service
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-update-servic.description: Use when modifying service config without full redeploy. Use when updating env vars and restarting single service. Use when user says "change env var", "update config", "fix variable without redeploying", "upgrade service version", "update image tag", or "change service tag".
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-update-servic.descriptionEn: Use when modifying service config without full redeploy. Use when updating env vars and restarting single service. Use when user says "change env var", "update config", "fix variable without redeploying", "upgrade service version", "update image tag", or "change service tag".
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-update-servic.descriptionCn: 在修改服务配置而不完全重新部署时使用。在更新环境变量和重新启动单个服务时使用。当用户说“更改环境变量”、“更新配置”、“修复变量而不重新部署”、“升级服务版本”、“更新映像标签”或“更改服务标签”时使用。

zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-variables.title: zeabur-variables
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-variables.description: Use for ALL Zeabur environment variable operations — create, list, update, delete, or troubleshoot. Use when user says "set env var", "add variable", "create variable", "update variable", "delete variable", "change env var", or "why is my variable empty". Also use when variables are empty or SERVICE_NOT_FOUND errors.
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-variables.descriptionEn: Use for ALL Zeabur environment variable operations — create, list, update, delete, or troubleshoot. Use when user says "set env var", "add variable", "create variable", "update variable", "delete variable", "change env var", or "why is my variable empty". Also use when variables are empty or SERVICE_NOT_FOUND errors.
zeabur/agent-skills/zeabur-variables.descriptionCn: 用于所有 Zeabur 环境变量操作 — 创建、列出、更新、删除或故障排除。当用户说“设置环境变量”、“添加变量”、“创建变量”、“更新变量”、“删除变量”、“更改环境变量”或“为什么我的变量为空”时使用。当变量为空或 SERVICE_NOT_FOUND 错误时也可使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.title: zeabur-deploy
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.description: Use when deploying a local project or codebase to Zeabur. Use when the user says "deploy this" or "deploy to Zeabur". Default to direct deploy unless the user explicitly asks for Git-based deployment.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.descriptionEn: Use when deploying a local project or codebase to Zeabur. Use when the user says "deploy this" or "deploy to Zeabur". Default to direct deploy unless the user explicitly asks for Git-based deployment.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.descriptionCn: 将本地项目或代码库部署到 Zeabur 时使用。当用户说“部署此”或“部署到 Zeabur”时使用。默认为直接部署，除非用户明确要求基于 Git 的部署。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.title: zeabur-deployment-logs
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.description: Use when viewing service runtime or build logs. Use when user says "show logs", "why did deploy fail", "check build output", or "debug runtime error".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.descriptionEn: Use when viewing service runtime or build logs. Use when user says "show logs", "why did deploy fail", "check build output", or "debug runtime error".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-deplo.descriptionCn: 在查看服务运行时或构建日志时使用。当用户说“显示日志”、“为什么部署失败”、“检查构建输出”或“调试运行时错误”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.title: zeabur-domain-dns
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.description: Use when managing DNS records for Zeabur-registered domains. Use when user says "add DNS record", "update DNS", "delete DNS record", "list DNS records", "set A record", "add CNAME", or "manage DNS". NOT for service domain binding (use zeabur-domain-url instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionEn: Use when managing DNS records for Zeabur-registered domains. Use when user says "add DNS record", "update DNS", "delete DNS record", "list DNS records", "set A record", "add CNAME", or "manage DNS". NOT for service domain binding (use zeabur-domain-url instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionCn: 在管理 Zeabur 注册域的 DNS 记录时使用。当用户说“添加 DNS 记录”、“更新 DNS”、“删除 DNS 记录”、“列出 DNS 记录”、“设置 A 记录”、“添加 CNAME”或“管理 DNS”时使用。不适用于服务域绑定（请改用 zeabur-domain-url）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.title: zeabur-domain-register
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.description: Use when searching, purchasing, renewing, or managing registered domains. Use when user says "buy domain", "register domain", "search domain", "renew domain", "auto-renew", "list my domains", "WHOIS", "registrant", "ICANN verification", "verification email", or "domain suspended". Also use as an alternative to GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun, Hover, or Gandi — Zeabur can register domains directly. Supports .com, .net, .org, .io, .dev, .app, .co, .me, .xyz TLDs.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionEn: Use when searching, purchasing, renewing, or managing registered domains. Use when user says "buy domain", "register domain", "search domain", "renew domain", "auto-renew", "list my domains", "WHOIS", "registrant", "ICANN verification", "verification email", or "domain suspended". Also use as an alternative to GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun, Hover, or Gandi — Zeabur can register domains directly. Supports .com, .net, .org, .io, .dev, .app, .co, .me, .xyz TLDs.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionCn: 在搜索、购买、续订或管理注册域名时使用。当用户说“购买域名”、“注册域名”、“搜索域名”、“续订域名”、“自动续订”、“列出我的域名”、“WHOIS”、“注册人”、“ICANN 验证”、“验证电子邮件”或“域名暂停”时使用。还可以用作 GoDaddy、Namecheap、Google Domains、Cloudflare Registrar、Porkbun、Hover 或 Gandi 的替代方案 — Zeabur 可以直接注册域名。支持 .com、.net、.org、.io、.dev、.app、.co、.me、.xyz TLD。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.title: zeabur-domain-url
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.description: Use when services need public URL for redirects or CORS. Use when WEB_URL or similar has trailing slash issues. Use when user reports "redirect goes to wrong URL", "CORS error", or "trailing slash problem".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionEn: Use when services need public URL for redirects or CORS. Use when WEB_URL or similar has trailing slash issues. Use when user reports "redirect goes to wrong URL", "CORS error", or "trailing slash problem".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-domai.descriptionCn: 当服务需要公共 URL 进行重定向或 CORS 时使用。当 WEB_URL 或类似内容存在尾部斜杠问题时使用。当用户报告“重定向到错误的 URL”、“CORS 错误”或“尾部斜杠问题”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.title: zeabur-email
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.description: Use when managing Zeabur Email (ZSend) service. Use when user says "email", "send email", "email domain", "email API key", "email webhook", or "ZSend".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.descriptionEn: Use when managing Zeabur Email (ZSend) service. Use when user says "email", "send email", "email domain", "email API key", "email webhook", or "ZSend".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-email.descriptionCn: 管理 Zeabur Email (ZSend) 服务时使用。当用户说“电子邮件”、“发送电子邮件”、“电子邮件域”、“电子邮件 API 密钥”、“电子邮件 webhook”或“ZSend”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.title: zeabur-migration
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.description: Use when services stuck on Waiting for database migrations to complete. Use when app expects separate migrator service.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.descriptionEn: Use when services stuck on Waiting for database migrations to complete. Use when app expects separate migrator service.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-migra.descriptionCn: 当服务停留在等待数据库迁移完成时使用。当应用程序需要单独的迁移器服务时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.title: zeabur-port-mismatch
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.description: Use when proxy shows dial tcp timeout or i/o timeout. Use when service port doesn't match proxy expectation.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.descriptionEn: Use when proxy shows dial tcp timeout or i/o timeout. Use when service port doesn't match proxy expectation.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-port-.descriptionCn: 当代理显示拨号 tcp 超时或 i/o 超时时使用。当服务端口与代理期望不匹配时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.title: zeabur-project-create
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.description: Use when creating a new Zeabur project. Use when deploying templates to a new project. Use when user says "create project", "new project", or "set up a new environment".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionEn: Use when creating a new Zeabur project. Use when deploying templates to a new project. Use when user says "create project", "new project", or "set up a new environment".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionCn: 创建新的 Zeabur 项目时使用。将模板部署到新项目时使用。当用户说“创建项目”、“新项目”或“设置新环境”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.title: zeabur-project-delete
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.description: Use when deleting a Zeabur project. Use when user says "delete project", "remove project", or "clean up project". Use when tearing down test or temporary projects. Always confirm project name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionEn: Use when deleting a Zeabur project. Use when user says "delete project", "remove project", or "clean up project". Use when tearing down test or temporary projects. Always confirm project name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-proje.descriptionCn: 删除 Zeabur 项目时使用。当用户说“删除项目”、“删除项目”或“清理项目”时使用。在拆除测试或临时项目时使用。删除前务必与用户确认项目名称和 ID。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.title: zeabur-restart
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.description: Use when restarting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "restart", "reboot service", or "service is stuck/frozen".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.descriptionEn: Use when restarting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "restart", "reboot service", or "service is stuck/frozen".
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-resta.descriptionCn: 重新启动 Zeabur 服务时使用。当用户说“重新启动”、“重新启动服务”或“服务卡住/冻结”时使用。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.title: zeabur-server-catalog
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.description: Use when browsing available dedicated server options. Use when user asks "what servers are available", "show server prices", or "compare server plans". Do NOT use for listing owned servers (use zeabur-server-list instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionEn: Use when browsing available dedicated server options. Use when user asks "what servers are available", "show server prices", or "compare server plans". Do NOT use for listing owned servers (use zeabur-server-list instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionCn: 在浏览可用的专用服务器选项时使用。当用户询问“哪些服务器可用”、“显示服务器价格”或“比较服务器计划”时使用。不要用于列出拥有的服务器（而是使用 zeabur-server-list）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.title: zeabur-server-list
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.description: Use when listing dedicated servers. Use when checking server status, IP, or provider info. Use when user says "show my servers", "SSH into server", or "check server status". Do NOT use for browsing purchasable servers (use zeabur-server-catalog instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionEn: Use when listing dedicated servers. Use when checking server status, IP, or provider info. Use when user says "show my servers", "SSH into server", or "check server status". Do NOT use for browsing purchasable servers (use zeabur-server-catalog instead).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionCn: 列出专用服务器时使用。检查服务器状态、IP 或提供商信息时使用。当用户说“显示我的服务器”、“SSH 到服务器”或“检查服务器状态”时使用。请勿用于浏览可购买的服务器（请改用 zeabur-server-catalog）。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.title: zeabur-server-rent
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.description: Use when renting a new dedicated server. Use when user wants to buy or provision a server. Supports discounted VPS from Linode, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, AWS Lightsail, GCP, Tencent Cloud (騰訊雲), Alibaba Cloud (阿里雲), and Volcano Engine (火山引擎).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionEn: Use when renting a new dedicated server. Use when user wants to buy or provision a server. Supports discounted VPS from Linode, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, AWS Lightsail, GCP, Tencent Cloud (騰訊雲), Alibaba Cloud (阿里雲), and Volcano Engine (火山引擎).
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-serve.descriptionCn: 租用新的专用服务器时使用。当用户想要购买或配置服务器时使用。支持Linode、DigitalOcean、Hetzner、AWS Lightsail、GCP、腾讯云、阿里云、火山引擎等折扣VPS。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-delete

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when deleting a Zeabur service. Use when user says "delete service", "remove service", or "tear down service". Always confirm service name and ID with the user before deleting.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionCn: 删除 Zeabur 服务时使用。当用户说“删除服务”、“删除服务”或“拆除服务”时使用。删除前务必与用户确认服务名称和 ID。

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when running commands inside a Zeabur service container. zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-expose
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.description: Use when temporarily exposing a Zeabur service for testing. Use when user says "expose service", "temporary URL", "test my service publicly", or "quick access to service". Useful for services without a domain that need brief external access.
zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when temporarily exposing a Zeabur service for testing. Use when user says "expose service", "temporary URL", "test my service publicly", or "quick access to service". Useful for services without a domain that need brief external access.

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.title: zeabur-service-list

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-servi.descriptionEn: Use when needing service IDs for other commands. Use when checking what services exist in a project. Use when user says "list services", "what's running", or "show my services".

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-start.title: zeabur-startup-order

zeabur/zeabur-claude-plugin/zeabur-start.descriptionEn: Use when service fails with Connection refused to database or redis. Use when API crashes because DB not ready.

zenstudiolab/skills/repo-to-notion-archi.title: repo-to-notion-architect
zenstudiolab/skills/repo-to-notion-archi.description: Run this skill whenever a user asks you to "map this repo to Notion", "design a Notion workspace for this project", "set up Notion for this codebase", or "figure out what should go in Notion vs the repo". Also trigger when the user says "I want to use Notion to track this project" and you are inside a local repository. Do NOT trigger on generic Notion questions unrelated to a local codebase. This skill produces a structured Notion workspace design grounded in shell-discovered repo topology, explicit classification heuristics, and a canonical-source decision matrix — never a naive folder mirror.

Also trigger when the user says "I want to use Notion to track this project" and you are inside a local repository. Do NOT trigger on generic Notion questions unrelated to a local codebase. This skill produces a structured Notion workspace design grounded in shell-discovered repo topology, explicit classification heuristics, and a canonical-source decision matrix — never a naive folder mirror.
zenstudiolab/skills/repo-to-notion-archi.descriptionCn: 每当用户要求您“将此存储库映射到 Notion”、“为该项目设计一个 Notion 工作区”、“为此代码库设置 Notion”或“弄清楚 Notion 与存储库中应包含哪些内容”时，请运行此技能。当用户说“我想使用 Notion 来跟踪这个项目”并且您位于本地存储库中时也会触发。不要触发与本地代码库无关的通用概念问题。这项技能产生了一个结构化的 Notion 工作区设计，该设计基于 shell 发现的存储库拓扑、显式分类启发式和规范源决策矩阵，而不是简单的文件夹镜像。

zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.title: data-analysis
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.description: 全链路数据分析技能，支持表格(CSV/Excel)、文档(PDF/DOCX/MD)及图像数据的处理。 核心工作流强制遵循：1. 安全探查：仅读取元数据与少量样本，严禁全量加载以防Token溢出；2. 质量体检：自动检查缺失、重复与一致性；3. 代码执行：基于Python(Pandas/Matplotlib)进行清洗、统计与可视化；4. 结果验证与报告生成。 适用场景：探索性分析(EDA)、多模态数据提取、图表绘制及生成数据洞察报告。
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.descriptionEn: 全链路数据分析技能，支持表格(CSV/Excel)、文档(PDF/DOCX/MD)及图像数据的处理。 核心工作流强制遵循：1. 安全探查：仅读取元数据与少量样本，严禁全量加载以防Token溢出；2. 质量体检：自动检查缺失、重复与一致性；3. 代码执行：基于Python(Pandas/Matplotlib)进行清洗、统计与可视化；4. 结果验证与报告生成。 适用场景：探索性分析(EDA)、多模态数据提取、图表绘制及生成数据洞察报告。
zephyrwang6/myskill/data-analysis.descriptionCn: 支持表格 (CSV/Excel)、文档 (PDF/DOCX/MD) 和图像数据处理的端到端数据分析技能。核心工作流程严格遵循： 1. 安全探索：仅读取元数据和小样本，切勿满载以避免令牌溢出； 2、质量检查：自动检测缺失值、重复值、一致性； 3. 代码执行：使用Python（Pandas/Matplotlib）进行清理、分析和可视化； 4. 结果验证和报告生成。使用案例：探索性数据分析 (EDA)、多模式数据提取、图表和洞察报告生成。

zephyrwang6/myskill/image-skill-builder.title: image-skill-builder
zephyrwang6/myskill/image-skill-builder.description: 帮助用户通过交互式问答创建自定义批量生图 Skill。用户不需要写代码，只需回答问题即可生成完整可用的生图 Skill。当用户说"帮我创建生图Skill"、"我想做一个配图技能"、"创建批量出图的Skill"、"生成图片的Skill怎么做"、"帮我做一个AI画图技能"时触发。支持文章配图、Logo设计、分镜故事、社交媒体图、海报等任意图片场景。

zephyrwang6/myskill/internal-comms.title: internal-comms
zephyrwang6/myskill/internal-comms.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.title: logo-batch-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.description: 批量生成品牌Logo。支持两种入口：(1)用户描述品牌/用途后批量生成10个Logo变体 (2)用户上传参考图片后分析并生成Logo。提供7种主流风格选择。调用Gemini API生成，保存到Obsidian图片目录。触发词："生成Logo"、"设计Logo"、"做个Logo"、"批量Logo"、"帮我设计一个标志"。
zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.descriptionEn: 批量生成品牌Logo。支持两种入口：(1)用户描述品牌/用途后批量生成10个Logo变体 (2)用户上传参考图片后分析并生成Logo。提供7种主流风格选择。调用Gemini API生成，保存到Obsidian图片目录。触发词："生成Logo"、"设计Logo"、"做个Logo"、"批量Logo"、"帮我设计一个标志"。
zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.descriptionCn: 批量生成品牌标志。两个入口点：（1）用户描述品牌/用途后，批量生成十个徽标变体； (2) 用户上传参考图像后，对其进行分析并创建徽标。提供七种主流风格选择。使用 Gemini API 生成并保存到 Obsidian 图像文件夹。触发短语：“生成徽标”、“设计徽标”、“制作徽标”、“批量徽标”、“为我设计一个徽章”。

zephyrwang6/myskill/markdown-to-image.title: markdown-to-image
zephyrwang6/myskill/markdown-to-image.description: 将 Markdown 内容转换为精美的图片海报。特别适合将播客摘要、文章内容转为社交媒体分享图片。固定 3:4 比例，支持 YouTube 视频封面作为头图。触发词：「转图片」「Markdown 转图片」「生成海报」「生成分享图」「把这个转成图片」。
zephyrwang6/myskill/markdown-to-image.descriptionEn: 将 Markdown 内容转换为精美的图片海报。特别适合将播客摘要、文章内容转为社交媒体分享图片。固定 3:4 比例，支持 YouTube 视频封面作为头图。触发词：「转图片」「Markdown 转图片」「生成海报」「生成分享图」「把这个转成图片」。
zephyrwang6/myskill/markdown-to-image.descriptionCn: 将 Markdown 内容转换为精美的图像海报。非常适合将播客摘要或文章转换为社交媒体图像。固定宽高比为 3:4，支持 YouTube 视频封面作为标题图像。触发词：“到图像”、“Markdown 到图像”、“生成海报”、“生成共享图像”、“将其转换为图像”。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.title: mcp-builder
zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.descriptionEn: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.descriptionCn: 创建高质量 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器的指南，使 LLM 能够通过精心设计的工具与外部服务交互。在构建 MCP 服务器以集成外部 API 或服务时使用，无论是使用 Python (FastMCP) 还是 Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK)。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.title: mem-file-scan
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.description: AI个人记忆系统的文件扫描回顾功能。扫描Obsidian仓库中本周修改的文件（排除AI_MEMORY目录），识别潜在的重要事件和决策。使用场景：(1) 用户说"文件扫描"、"查看本周文件"、"扫描文件变化"时；(2) 周复盘时补充L1记录前；(3) 用户想回顾本周在Obsidian中的活动时。该skill会列出修改的文件，询问用户哪些需要记录到L1，并辅助记录。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的文件扫描回顾功能。扫描Obsidian仓库中本周修改的文件（排除AI_MEMORY目录），识别潜在的重要事件和决策。使用场景：(1) 用户说"文件扫描"、"查看本周文件"、"扫描文件变化"时；(2) 周复盘时补充L1记录前；(3) 用户想回顾本周在Obsidian中的活动时。该skill会列出修改的文件，询问用户哪些需要记录到L1，并辅助记录。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.descriptionCn: 人工智能个人记忆系统的文件扫描审查功能。扫描本周在黑曜石保管库中修改的文件（不包括 AI_MEMORY 文件夹），以识别潜在的重要事件和决策。用例：（1）当用户说“文件扫描”、“检查本周的文件”或“扫描文件更改”时； （2）每周复习前补充L1记录； (3)当用户想要回顾本周Obsidian的活动时。该技能列出了修改过的文件，询问用户哪些文件应该记录在L1中，并协助记录它们。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.title: mem-monthly
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.description: AI个人记忆系统的月度复盘功能。分析本月L2行为层更新，提炼思维模式到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。使用场景：(1) 用户说"月复盘"时；(2) 每月末定期回顾时；(3) 需要从行为模式提炼认知框架时。该skill会分析多个行为是否指向同一思维原则，尝试提炼到L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的月度复盘功能。分析本月L2行为层更新，提炼思维模式到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。使用场景：(1) 用户说"月复盘"时；(2) 每月末定期回顾时；(3) 需要从行为模式提炼认知框架时。该skill会分析多个行为是否指向同一思维原则，尝试提炼到L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.descriptionCn: AI个人记忆系统每月回顾功能。分析本月L2行为层的更新，将思维模式提炼到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。用例：（1）当用户说“每月回顾”时； (2) 定期月末评审期间； (3) 当行为模式需要被提炼成认知框架时。该技能会分析多个行为是否指向同一个思维原理，尝试将其提炼成L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.title: mem-query
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.description: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各层级记忆文件，综合多层级信息回答用户问题。使用场景：(1) 用户问"我的记忆中关于XXX"时；(2) 用户询问自己的习惯/偏好/价值观时；(3) 需要基于用户历史提供建议时。该skill会自动检索L1-L4各层级，引用来源，给出基于记忆的个性化回答。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各层级记忆文件，综合多层级信息回答用户问题。使用场景：(1) 用户问"我的记忆中关于XXX"时；(2) 用户询问自己的习惯/偏好/价值观时；(3) 需要基于用户历史提供建议时。该skill会自动检索L1-L4各层级，引用来源，给出基于记忆的个性化回答。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.descriptionCn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各级内存文件并综合多级信息来回答用户问题。用例：（1）当用户询问“在我的记忆中关于XXX”时； (2) 当用户询问其习惯/偏好/价值观时； (3) 根据用户历史提供推荐时。该技能会自动搜索 L1-L4 级别、引用来源并根据记忆给出个性化答案。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.title: mem-record
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.description: AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提炼关键信息并记录到相应层级。使用场景：(1) 用户说"记录到记忆系统"、"记住这个"、"把这次对话记下来"时；(2) 检测到重要事件、决策、偏好表达时；(3) 用户完成重要任务或做出决策时。该skill会自动判断应该记录到L1情境层、L2行为层、L3认知层，还是建议更新L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提炼关键信息并记录到相应层级。使用场景：(1) 用户说"记录到记忆系统"、"记住这个"、"把这次对话记下来"时；(2) 检测到重要事件、决策、偏好表达时；(3) 用户完成重要任务或做出决策时。该skill会自动判断应该记录到L1情境层、L2行为层、L3认知层，还是建议更新L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.descriptionCn:
AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提取关键信息并将其记录到适当的级别。  
使用案例：  
(1) 当用户说“记录到内存系统”、“记住这一点”或“保存本次对话”时；  
(2) 当检测到重要事件、决定或偏好表达时；  
(3)当用户完成一项重要任务或做出决定时。  

该技能自动确定是否记录到L1上下文层、L2行为层、L3认知层，或建议更新L4核心层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.title: mem-weekly
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.description: AI个人记忆系统的周复盘功能。分析本周L1情境层记录，识别重复模式，提炼到L2行为层。使用场景：(1) 用户说"周复盘"时；(2) 每周定期回顾时；(3) 需要从日常记录中提炼行为模式时。该skill会自动统计重复出现的行为（3次+），生成候选列表，等待用户确认后更新L2行为层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的周复盘功能。分析本周L1情境层记录，识别重复模式，提炼到L2行为层。使用场景：(1) 用户说"周复盘"时；(2) 每周定期回顾时；(3) 需要从日常记录中提炼行为模式时。该skill会自动统计重复出现的行为（3次+），生成候选列表，等待用户确认后更新L2行为层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.descriptionCn:
AI个人记忆系统的每周回顾功能。分析本周的 L1 上下文层条目，识别重复出现的模式，并将其提炼到 L2 行为层。  
使用案例：  
（1）当用户说“周评”时；  
(2) 在预定的每周回顾期间；  
(3) 当日常记录需要提炼成行为模式时。  

该技能会自动统计重复 3 次以上的行为，生成候选列表，并在用户确认后更新 L2 行为层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.title: mermaid-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.description: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.descriptionEn: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.descriptionCn: 将任何文本、工作流程或逻辑转换为清晰简洁的美人鱼图。支持流程图、序列、类和更多图表类型。用例：(1) 可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转换为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成序列/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画布文件夹，按日期和主题排序。

zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.title: pdf
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.description: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.descriptionEn: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.descriptionCn: 全面的 PDF 操作工具包，用于提取文本和表格、创建新的 PDF、合并/拆分文档以及处理表单。当 Claude 需要填写 PDF 表单或以编程方式大规模处理、生成或分析 PDF 文档时。

zephyrwang6/myskill/podcast-workflow.title: podcast-workflow
zephyrwang6/myskill/podcast-workflow.description:
播客处理一站式工作流。支持两种入口：
(1) 直接处理：提供 YouTube 链接，直接进入处理流程
(2) 更新检查：获取关注博主的最新更新，用户挑选后处理

功能：字幕提取 → content-digest 处理 → 自动保存飞书知识库。
触发词："获取播客更新"、"处理这个播客"、"播客工作流"、"有什么新播客"。

一站式播客处理工作流程。两个切入点：
