zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.descriptionEn: Systematic methodology for constructing compact (<150 lines), expressive, Claude Code-integrated subagent prompts using lambda contracts and symbolic logic. Use when creating new specialized subagents for Claude Code with agent composition, MCP tool integration, or skill references. Validated with phase-planner-executor (V_instance=0.895).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.descriptionCn: 使用 lambda 契约和符号逻辑构建紧凑（<150 行）、富有表现力、Claude 代码集成的子代理提示的系统方法。在通过代理组合、MCP 工具集成或技能参考为 Claude Code 创建新的专用子代理时使用。使用阶段规划器执行器进行验证（V_instance=0.895）。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.title: suno-song
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.description: Transform diverse inputs (YouTube videos/audio, existing Suno songs, raw lyrics, audio files, or conversational ideas) into highly optimized Suno V5 custom song generation prompts with intelligent character optimization (5000 lyrics, 1000 style limits), proven metatag reliability, V5-enhanced emotion tags, and template-based best practices. Use when user wants to create music with Suno, provides content for song generation, or needs help crafting effective V5 prompts.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.descriptionEn: Transform diverse inputs (YouTube videos/audio, existing Suno songs, raw lyrics, audio files, or conversational ideas) into highly optimized Suno V5 custom song generation prompts with intelligent character optimization (5000 lyrics, 1000 style limits), proven metatag reliability, V5-enhanced emotion tags, and template-based best practices. Use when user wants to create music with Suno, provides content for song generation, or needs help crafting effective V5 prompts.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.descriptionCn: 通过智能字符优化（5000 句歌词、1000 种风格限制）、经过验证的元标签可靠性、V5 增强型情感标签和基于模板的最佳实践，将各种输入（YouTube 视频/音频、现有 Suno 歌曲、原始歌词、音频文件或对话想法）转换为高度优化的 Suno V5 自定义歌曲生成提示。当用户想要使用 Suno 创建音乐、提供歌曲生成内容或需要帮助制作有效的 V5 提示时使用。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.title: tapestry

Automatically detects content type (YouTube video, article, PDF) and processes accordingly.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.descriptionEn: Unified content extraction and action planning. zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.descriptionCn: 统一的内容提取和行动规划。当用户说“tapestry [URL]”、“weave [URL]”、“help me plan [URL]”、“extract and plan [URL]”、“make this actionable [URL]”或类似短语表示他们想要提取内容并创建行动计划时使用。自动检测内容类型（YouTube 视频、文章、PDF）并进行相应处理。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.title: Technical Debt Management
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.description: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Use when technical debt unmeasured or subjective, need objective prioritization, planning refactoring work, establishing debt prevention practices, or tracking debt trends over time. zreadai/zread-skill/zread.title: zread
zreadai/zread-skill/zread.description: Produce and consume a wiki-style knowledge base for a code repository via the `zread` CLI and its on-disk output under `./.zread/wiki/`. Use this skill whenever the user wants to understand, onboard onto, explore, summarize, map, or get an overview of an unfamiliar codebase; asks for architecture docs, a project wiki, a repo walkthrough, module/package explanations, or "what does this repo do"; wants to generate, regenerate, resume, browse, or serve code documentation locally; or mentions zread / zread.ai directly. Also use it proactively before diving into a large unknown repo — if `./.zread/wiki/current` exists, read the generated pages instead of crawling source file-by-file; if it doesn't, consider offering to run `zread generate`. The trigger is the intent (understand a codebase through generated docs), not the literal word "zread".

zrosenbauer/skills/code-reviewer.title: code-reviewer
zrosenbauer/skills/code-reviewer.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to review code, audit a diff, get a second opinion on changes, or run an adversarial review. Picks one of four reviewer personas (adversarial, security, architecture, performance), supports a PR sub-mode via `gh pr diff`, and can hand off to any detected AI CLI for a cross-model second opinion. Skip when the user wants formatting fixes (use a linter) or refactoring patterns (use ts-best-practices or ts-best-practices-functional).

zrosenbauer/skills/code-reviewer.descriptionCn: 当用户想要审查代码、审核差异、获得有关更改的第二意见或运行对抗性审查时，应该使用此技能。常见的触发因素包括“审查此代码”、“审核此差异”、“查找问题”、“对此的第二意见”、“严厉审查”、“审查 PR”、“对抗性审查”和“安全审查”。选择四个审阅者角色（对抗性、安全性、架构、性能）之一，通过“gh pr diff”支持 PR 子模式，并可以移交给任何检测到的 AI CLI 以获得跨模型第二意见。当用户想要格式修复（使用 linter）或重构模式（使用 ts-best-practices 或 ts-best-practices-function）时跳过。

zrosenbauer/skills/skill-eval.title: skill-eval
zrosenbauer/skills/skill-eval.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to run baseline evaluations on existing agent skills, regenerate transcripts after a model upgrade, or check whether a skill still solves the gap it was authored for. Common triggers include "rerun the baselines", "re-eval skill X", "test all the skills", "check for skill drift", and "run the evals". Bakes in verbatim transcript capture (no paraphrasing), deterministic-only grading (regex / contains / file_exists — no LLM-as-judge), and the iteration-N workspace convention. Skip when authoring a new skill (use skill-creator) or modifying skill content directly.

zrosenbauer/skills/svg-creator.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to create, fix, or convert SVG assets in any project — banners, badges, icons, logos, window/IDE mockups, terminal screenshots, or diagram nodes. Skip when the asset is purely raster (no SVG source) or when only an existing PNG needs editing.

zsy1207/atmospheric-science-research-ski.title: atmospheric-science-research
zsy1207/atmospheric-science-research-ski.description: Use this skill for file-based atmospheric or climate work with a real project structure rather than a one-off answer. Trigger it for NetCDF, GRIB, reanalysis, ERA5, CMIP, WRF, model output, EOF or PCA, climatology, anomaly, regression, composite, or other atmospheric diagnostics when the task involves planning, diagnostics or statistics, regridding, reusable computation, compute-vs-plot separation, publication-grade figures, or review of actual outputs. Also use it for existing atmospheric figure files or small figure-only patches inside an existing atmospheric or climate project when labels, levels, colorbars, legends, panel letters, layout, or exports need fixing without changing the scientific method. Do not use it for forecasts, literature summaries, pure writing, generic plotting outside atmospheric science, app or UI work, deployment, or simple one-step downloads.

ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.title: hyperframes-shorts
ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.description: HyperFrames 中文短视频视觉与版式预处理规范（抖音/小红书竖屏可读）。适用于任意镜头数量的中文解说视频。必须先读本 Skill，再读 hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、gsap；写 HTML 前必须读 design-taste-frontend（taste-skill）、templates/anti-slop-motion-scheme.md、templates/hyperframes-zh-checklist.md、css-animations、design-motion-principles、web-typography 与 templates/visual-style-guide.md，每项目须产出 design.md（含 Motion Plan）并轮换视觉风格，禁止套同一模板。硬性版式：底部字幕永远单行、页面文字不得重叠、中文须本地 fonts/ + @font-face（禁 PingFang/微软雅黑/Google Fonts）、禁止 AI 风 emoji/表情包式插图；动效：L0 `#root` 静态背景 + L1 入场 + L2 语义对齐 TTS 必做（禁止每镜 CSS infinite ambient）。交付前必须跑 verify-delivery-checklist.py + verify-index-encoding.py + npm run check（0 error）。中文 TTS 默认 Edge TTS（generate-tts.py）；TTS 后必须 align-subtitles.py（faster-whisper 词级时间戳）再 apply-audio-schedule.mjs；不需要 hyperframes-media。Agent 须自动跑完全部环境与构建（预检、脚手架、TTS、对齐、时间轴、校验），用户只需手动 npm run dev 预览；禁止自动 render 导出 MP4，须等用户确认后再导出。口播（voice）与字幕（subtitle）分离：TTS 按口播整句生成，禁止为字幕单行上限拆分 TTS。将用户的口播稿按语义拆分为多个场景，生成上屏文案、规划布局、分配时长、指定转场和动效，并统筹配音/BGM/音效编排。
ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.descriptionEn: HyperFrames 中文短视频视觉与版式预处理规范（抖音/小红书竖屏可读）。适用于任意镜头数量的中文解说视频。必须先读本 Skill，再读 hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、gsap；写 HTML 前必须读 design-taste-frontend（taste-skill）、templates/anti-slop-motion-scheme.md、templates/hyperframes-zh-checklist.md、css-animations、design-motion-principles、web-typography 与 templates/visual-style-guide.md，每项目须产出 design.md（含 Motion Plan）并轮换视觉风格，禁止套同一模板。硬性版式：底部字幕永远单行、页面文字不得重叠、中文须本地 fonts/ + @font-face（禁 PingFang/微软雅黑/Google Fonts）、禁止 AI 风 emoji/表情包式插图；动效：L0 `#root` 静态背景 + L1 入场 + L2 语义对齐 TTS 必做（禁止每镜 CSS infinite ambient）。交付前必须跑 verify-delivery-checklist.py + verify-index-encoding.py + npm run check（0 error）。中文 TTS 默认 Edge TTS（generate-tts.py）；TTS 后必须 align-subtitles.py（faster-whisper 词级时间戳）再 apply-audio-schedule.mjs；不需要 hyperframes-media。Agent 须自动跑完全部环境与构建（预检、脚手架、TTS、对齐、时间轴、校验），用户只需手动 npm run dev 预览；禁止自动 render 导出 MP4，须等用户确认后再导出。口播（voice）与字幕（subtitle）分离：TTS 按口播整句生成，禁止为字幕单行上限拆分 TTS。将用户的口播稿按语义拆分为多个场景，生成上屏文案、规划布局、分配时长、指定转场和动效，并统筹配音/BGM/音效编排。
ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.descriptionCn:
HyperFrames中文短视频视觉和布局预处理规范（抖音/小红书竖屏可读）。适用于任意镜头数量的中文解说视频。必须先阅读此技能，然后阅读hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、gsap；在编写 HTML 之前，您必须阅读 design-taste-frontend (taste-skill)、templates/anti-slop-motion-scheme.md、templates/hyperframes-zh-checklist.md、css-animations、design-motion-principles、web-typography 和 templates/visual-style-guide.md。对于每个项目，您必须生成一个 design.md（包括运动计划）并旋转视觉样式；禁止重复使用相同的模板。

硬布局规则：底部字幕必须始终为单行，页面文本不得重叠，中文必须使用本地字体/ + @font-face（禁止使用苹果、微软雅黑、谷歌字体），禁止使用AI风格的表情符号或meme风格的插图；动画：L0`#root`静态背景+L1入口+L2语义对齐。 TTS 是强制性的（禁止每次拍摄 CSS 无限环境光）。

在交付之前，您必须运行 verify-delivery-checklist.py + verify-index-encoding.py + npm run check（零错误）。中文TTS默认为Edge TTS（generate-tts.py）； TTS 之后，您必须运行align-subtitles.py（更快的耳语单词级时间戳），然后运行apply-audio-schedule.mjs；不需要超帧媒体。

Agent必须自动完成整个环境和构建过程（预检查、脚手架、TTS、对齐、时间线、验证）；用户只需要手动运行 npm run dev 即可预览。禁止自动渲染/导出到 MP4 - 导出必须等待用户确认。

语音（voice）和字幕（subtitle）是分开的：TTS是根据所说的句子生成的，并且TTS不得被分割以满足字幕单行限制。将用户的口语脚本在语义上分割为多个场景，生成屏幕副本，规划布局，分配持续时间，指定转场和动画，并协调画外音/背景音乐/音效安排。

zzh-editor/media-downloader/media-downlo.title: media-downloader
zzh-editor/media-downloader/media-downlo.description: 基于 yt-dlp 和 gallery-dl 的素材下载技能，覆盖 YouTube、Bilibili、Vimeo、ArtStation 等数百个站点。 当用户给出视频/图片链接请求下载时，必须使用此技能——包括但不限于："下载这个视频"、"把这个下了"、 "帮我下这个"、"下载链接"、"保存这个视频"、"下载 B 站"、"下这个 youtube"、"ArtStation 下载"、 "把这个项目下了"、"下个视频"、"帮我下个东西"等。技能自动处理清晰度选择（超过1080p询问用户）、 时间节点切片下载、ArtStation 项目按用户名/项目名组织。 gallery-dl 专门用于图片画廊类网站下载（ArtStation、Pixiv、DeviantArt 等）。 任何时候用户提供 URL 并涉及下载行为，优先考虑此技能。

zzh-editor/srt-enhancer/srt-enhancer.title: srt-enhancer
zzh-editor/srt-enhancer/srt-enhancer.description: 必须触发：当用户说"优化字幕"、"增强字幕"、"优化这个字幕"、"增强这个字幕"等以"优化"或"增强"开头且包含"字幕"的请求。也用于处理 .srt 字幕，执行去口癖、校准ASR错误、修正的/得/地、中西文混排空格、去除多余标点、标记《》书名号。如果用于非字幕任务，返回空或无效响应。Also triggers on "optimize subtitles", "enhance SRT", "clean up ASR transcript", "filler removal", "subtitle punctuation".
